decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel was only ever mentioned, never featured, which suggests it performs modestly against aspirations, but it likely complements the firm's core security architecture at low marginal cost, so the slack of a mature medium firm lets it stay for now.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was promoted to a page of its own in 2019, which signals results at or above aspiration and a central role in the firm's security portfolio, so there is no shortfall prompting problemistic search.

The QR-code hardware signature token gained its own page in 2019, indicating management saw sufficient traction, though hardware carries higher costs and its sibling signature product B was already dropped, which leaves some risk.

The payment network security compliance suite addresses recurring regulatory demand that brings stable consulting revenue, so even with only moderate visibility it likely meets aspirations closely enough to be retained.
